summary: Iter165 (sample library) + iter166 (directory API swap) fully validated. Backend: 47/47 tests green (iter142:6, iter163:13, iter164:12, iter165:5, iter166:11). Frontend /samples page renders 30 cards across 7 categories including the 3 new cards (Foundation Statement Sample, Case Status Report Sample, Cost Splitter Ledger) and a new 'Activities Cost Splitter · 1' filter chip. All 3 new PDFs served at /downloads/* return HTTP 200 with valid %PDF- headers. GET /api/professional/directory still returns the 5 mock pros (env vars intentionally unset). No regressions detected.
critical_code_review_comments: professional_directory._fetch_directory() fallback design (no cache-poisoning on failure, immediate retry on next call) is well-tested and behaves correctly.
Row-level validation is strict (string id/name/contact_email required) — good defensive posture against malformed sibling payloads.
Non-blocker: multiple fpdf2 DeprecationWarnings surface during sample generation (ln=, dest=, txt= parameters). Consider upgrading to new_x/new_y and text= APIs in a maintenance pass.
test_credentials: parent1@test.com / TestPass123! — /samples page is public (no auth needed for this iteration).
seed_data_creation: None. Sample PDFs are pre-built and shipped in /app/frontend/public/downloads/.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter165 sample generators write to /app/frontend/public/downloads/ — do NOT run `python generate_samples.py` without monkeypatching OUT_DIR (overwrites shipping files, forces git-diff). Iter166 directory swap gated by SACOPARENTSALIGN_BASE_URL + SACOPARENTSALIGN_API_KEY — both remain UNSET in test env by design; app stays in mock mode. To exercise the sibling code path, set both env vars and monkeypatch httpx (see test_iter166_directory_api_swap.py for the FakeAsyncClient pattern).
